Messages.Author: Son Nguyen-Dang
Messages.Body:
Can anyone tell me if the +1 stealth is cumulative on Form of Mist eg.
if I play it a second time in the next combat (my prey manages to
block again) does my action now continue +2 stealth ? Thanks. -SOn
--

Messages.Author: massin
Messages.Body:
well the +1stealth is not cumulutative because it is assumed that if your
prey manages to block you again, she can fight with your vampire only
if she isn't in mist any more.
But if you play another form of mist, then combat end another time and you get
+1 stealth (not +2stealth)
Raphael aka Clarence Pickmann of Toreador Clan

Messages.Author: William S. Westermann
Messages.Body:
Maybe I'm misinterpreting the card, but it says that the action continues
with +1 stealth. I don't see any reason for it not to be cumulative.
(Unless that's a DTR or something. :)

Look at it like this.

Gitane St. Claire bleeds.
She gets blocked and uses FoM to end combat and continue her bleed at +1
stealth
Her prey incepts her bleed with an intercept.
She uses FoM which ends combat and continues her action at +1 stealth.

The previous action being blocked was a +1 stealh bleed, and therefore, after
playing FoM, should continue at +2 stealth.

I can't read the card any other way.

Just me.

Messages.Author: Mark Amidon
Messages.Body:
massin <n4086> writes:
>Date: 2 Jun 1995 11:07:01 GMT

>well the +1stealth is not cumulutative because it is assumed that if your
>prey manages to block you again, she can fight with your vampire only
>if she isn't in mist any more.
>But if you play another form of mist, then combat end another time and you get
>+1 stealth (not +2stealth)

No, non, nein. The '+' in "+1 stealth" means that you add the value to the
stealth already accumulated. Of course, the vampire that blocked you is
already at the necessary intercept level, so they need only add one more
intercept to get you again (assuming that they can overcome being tapped from
combat, of course).

The rule states that you lose the stealth or intercept _after_ the action is
resolved. Form of Mist continues the action.

Give my Gangrels a break, would you please?

Mark Amidon,
Nosferatu-in-training
Friend of Gangrels

Messages.Author: Joseph Cochran
Messages.Body:
In article <3qmrcl$o...@netserver.univ-lille1.fr>, massin <n4086> wrote:
>well the +1stealth is not cumulutative because it is assumed that if your
>prey manages to block you again, she can fight with your vampire only
>if she isn't in mist any more.

Form of Mist just grants the extra stealth. It gives no
provision for taking that stealth away again, and in general stealth
stays until the end of an action, so the stealth is indeed cumulative.
It may not be right with your fiction, but that *is* the way it works.
